answer: Each validator stakes 12,000 tokens into a vault where a quadratic erosion cuts effective stake by 0.5% per duplicate identity per epoch. Any Sybil cluster triggers a super-linear slashing penalty equal to the square of the bonded capital and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay on withdrawal. Because marginal cost grows as O(k^2), total spend exceeds extractable rewards 3.2x, yielding negative expected utility; a karst entropy beacon anchors the delay, securing a robust Nash equilibrium for the protocol's voyage to finality.
